boundary_explanation: Corner room on an intermediate apartment floor: south/east face outdoors; north/west exchange with rooms held at21 C. Ceiling/floor are zero-flux symmetry approximations to similarly operated rooms above/below, NOT ground or outdoor boundaries. These symmetry assumptions omit inter-storey exchange during unequal warm-up. Floor/ceiling each include80mm of a160mm shared concrete slab, with symmetry at its mid-plane; ceiling concrete is split into two equal layers solely to retain the existing three-layer network topology.
properties_source: All room construction, window U and ACH below are declared illustrative engineering assumptions, not measured construction or normative design values. Layer R=d/k; heat capacity=rho*cp*d*A. Air/film/radiant coefficients retain explicit C2 assumptions. No BESTEST material is scaled by floor area.
initialization: Only air/radiator cooled to15 C; all fabric starts20 C. This is an idealized air-cooled room with warm walls, NOT the C3.6 full cold soak. No claim of a preceding simulated cooling history.
gains: Zero solar and zero internal gains; no window solar model or occupancy assumption added.
